pre_survey.robot_interaction_description: While there are probably numerous examples depending on the flexibility of the definition of robot in this context, one anecdote is that I have interacted with the old Mindstorms robots (my older brother had a couple Mindstorms sets, he would set them up but he let me use them a little).
pre_survey.emotional_state_description: I feel mostly alright. I feel that my life circumstances are pretty good overall, but am stressed about certain immediate tasks (I have to find housing for next school year, for example). My mental state reflects this; I feel somewhat bothered on a visceral level but mostly comfortable on a more thoughtful level.

eeg_headset.discomfort_description: I don't think the headset made me itchy, but when I got itchy regardless and went to scratch my head I realized the headset was in the way and I didn't want to bump it. This discomfort was minor and the itchiness went away after a short period of time. There was pressure from the headset but it did not bother me to a significant degree.
